						end

function v_u_25.SimulateInputEnded(p112, p113) -- name: SimulateInputEnded
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_20, (copy) v_u_23, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_19, (copy) v_u_18, (copy) v_u_16
	if p112.LocalFighter then
		if v_u_20:GetPublicState() == v_u_20.CameraState.States.ThirdPersonUnlockedMouse and p113.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then
			return
		else
			for _, v114 in pairs(v_u_23) do
				if not (v_u_12:InputIs(p113, v114) and (p112:_IsToggleInput(v114) and v_u_19:IsToggled(v114))) then
					continue
				end
				return
			end
			if v_u_12:InputIs(p113, "Crouch") then
				if p112.IsCrouching then
					p112:SetCrouching(false)
					if p112:IsInputDown("Sprint") then
						p112:SetSprinting(true)
					end
				end
			elseif v_u_12:InputIs(p113, "Sprint") or v_u_12:InputIs(p113, "AutoSprint") then
				p112:SetSprinting(false)
			elseif v_u_12:InputIs(p113, "LeanLeft") then
				if p112._is_leaning_left then
					p112._is_leaning_left = false
					p112:SetCameraLean(p112.CameraLean + 1)
				end
			elseif v_u_12:InputIs(p113, "LeanRight") and p112._is_leaning_right then
				p112._is_leaning_right = false
				p112:SetCameraLean(p112.CameraLean - 1)
			end
			if v_u_12:InputIs(p113, "QuickMelee") then
				p112.LocalFighter:QuickAttackUp("Melee")
				return
			elseif v_u_12:InputIs(p113, "QuickUtility") then
				p112.LocalFighter:QuickAttackUp("Utility")
			elseif v_u_12:InputIs(p113, "OpenPlayerList") then
				if v_u_18.CurrentDuelSubject then
					v_u_18.CurrentDuelSubject.DuelInterface.Scoreboard:Open(false)
					return
				end
			elseif v_u_12:InputIs(p113, "UseEmote") and v_u_19.CurrentControls == "MouseKeyboard" then
				local v115 = v_u_16:GetPage("PickEmote")
				if v115 then
					v115:PickEarly()
					return
				end
			elseif p112.LocalFighter.EquippedItem then
				for _, v116 in pairs(v_u_12.ItemInputs) do
					if not v_u_12:InputIs(p113, v116) then
						continue
					end
					p112:EquippedItemInput(v_u_12.Inputs[v116].FinishName)
				end
			end
		end
	else
		return
	end
end

function v_u_25._InputSpam(p156, p157, p158) -- name: _InputSpam
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_5
	if p156._is_input_spamming[p157] then
		return
	end
	p156._is_input_spamming[p157] = true
	while p156.LocalFighter and (p156.LocalFighter.EquippedItem and (p156.LocalFighter.EquippedItem.Info.InputSpammingEnabled[p158] and (p156:IsInputDown(p157) and not p156.LocalFighter:Get("IsHiddenByCutscene")))) do
		local v159 = p156:_IsToggleInput(p157)
		p156:EquippedItemInput(p158)
		local v160 = not v159 and p156.LocalFighter.EquippedItem.Info.InputSpammingEnabled[p158]
		if not v160 then
			break
		end
		if v160 <= 0 then
			v_u_5.RenderStepped:Wait()
		else
			wait(v160)
		end
	end
	p156._is_input_spamming[p157] = false
end
function v_u_25._SpamJumpRequests(p161, ...) -- name: _SpamJumpRequests

		p161:JumpRequest(...)
		v_u_5.RenderStepped:Wait()
	end
end
function v_u_25._GetWalkSpeed(p162, p163) -- name: _GetWalkSpeed
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_8
	if p162:IsFrozen() then
		return 0
	end
	local v164 = p162.LocalFighter.Entity:IsEmoting()
	local v165 = p162.LocalFighter.Entity:GetCurrentEmote()
	local v166 = v_u_16:IsPageOpen()
	local v167 = (p162.IsSprinting and not v164 and (p162.LocalFighter:Get("SprintingSpeedBoost") or 0.5) or 0) + (p162.LocalFighter and p162.LocalFighter.Entity and (p162.LocalFighter.Entity:GetBoost("Speed") or 0) or 0)
	local v168 = v166 and v166.Name == "PickEmote" and 0 or 1
	local v169 = v164 and v_u_10.Cosmetics[v165.Name].TraversalWalkSpeedMultiplier or 1
	local v170 = p162.LocalFighter and p162.LocalFighter.EquippedItem and (p162.LocalFighter.EquippedItem.Info.WalkSpeedMultiplier or 1) or 1
	local v171 = p162.IsCrouching and 0.5 or 1
	local v172 = p162.IsSliding and not p163 and 0 or 1
	local v173 = v168 * v169 * v170 * v171 * v172
	return v_u_8.BASE_WALKSPEED * (1 + v167) * v173
end
function v_u_25._UpdateWalkSpeed(p174) -- name: _UpdateWalkSpeed

		p174.LocalFighter.Entity.Humanoid.WalkSpeed = p174:_GetWalkSpeed()
	end
end
function v_u_25._UpdateCharacterRotation(p175) -- name: _UpdateCharacterRotation
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_20

		if v176 and (v176 ~= v_u_20.CameraState.States.CustomFreecam and (v176 ~= v_u_20.CameraState.States.ThirdPersonUnlockedMouse or not v177)) then
			local v178 = workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.LookVector * Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
			if v178.Magnitude > 0.01 then

function v_u_27._UpdateHiddenArmSubmodels(p200, p201) -- name: _UpdateHiddenArmSubmodels

		local v204 = v203.HideInThirdPerson
		if v204 then
			v204 = not p201
		end
		local v205 = v204 and 1 or 0
		for _, v206 in pairs(v202:GetDescendants()) do
			if not v206:IsA("BasePart") then
				continue
			end
			p200:_LocalTransparencyModifier(v206, "HiddenArmSubmodel", v205)
		end
	end
end
function v_u_27._IsSubmodelBehindHead(p207, p208, p209) -- name: _IsSubmodelBehindHead
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_8
	local _ = p207._animation_context_submodels[p208]
	local v210 = p207.ClientItem.ClientFighter.Entity
	if v210 then
		v210 = p207.ClientItem.ClientFighter.Entity.Head or p207.ClientItem.ClientFighter.Entity.RootPart
	end
	if not (v210 and p208.PrimaryPart) then
		return false
	end
	local v211 = p209 or v210.CFrame.Rotation
	for _, v212 in pairs(p207._submodel_boundingbox_attachments[p208]) do
		if not v212.WorldPosition:FuzzyEq(v210.Position) and v_u_8:AngleBetweenVectors(v212.WorldPosition - v210.Position, v211.LookVector) >= 1.5707963267948966 then
			continue
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end
function v_u_27._StepBehindHeadSubmodels(p213, p214, p215) -- name: _StepBehindHeadSubmodels

			v217 = not p213:_IsSubmodelBehindHead(v216, p215)
		else
			v217 = p214
		end

		if p213._submodels_behind_head_values[v216] == v218 then
			continue
		end

		local v219 = v218 and 0 or 1
		for _, v220 in pairs(v216:GetDescendants()) do

		end
		if not p213.Charm or v216 ~= p213._charm_sub_model then

function v_u_17.FinishAiming(p88, _) -- name: FinishAiming

		v84 = v84.BattlePass

		return v_u_5.Bundles.primeseason_bundle
	end

		for _, v86 in pairs(v_u_5.BATTLE_PASS_LEVELS) do
			local v87 = v_u_5.Products[v86]

		end

	end

function v_u_18._PlayersLookupDropdown(p_u_99) -- name: _PlayersLookupDropdown
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_3, (copy) v_u_14
	if p_u_99._dropdown_slot then
		p_u_99._dropdown_slot:Cancel()
		p_u_99._dropdown_slot = nil
	end
	local v100 = v_u_10:CloneTable(p_u_99._cached_players)
	for _, v101 in pairs(v_u_3:GetPlayers()) do
		local v102 = string.upper(v101.DisplayName) .. " (@" .. string.upper(v101.Name) .. ")"
		if table.find(v100, v102) then
			continue
		end
		table.insert(v100, v102)
	end
	table.sort(v100, function(p103, p104)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_10
		return v_u_10:StringLessThan(p103, p104)
	end)
	p_u_99._dropdown_slot = v_u_14.new(p_u_99.DropdownReferenceFrame, v100)
	p_u_99._dropdown_slot.Selected:Connect(function(p105)
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_99
		p_u_99._dropdown_slot = nil
		if p105 then
			local v106 = p_u_99.LookupBox
			local v107 = string.find(p105, "@") + 1
			local v108 = #p105 - 1
			v106.Text = string.sub(p105, v107, v108)
			task.defer(p_u_99._FetchBanData, p_u_99)
		end
	end)
end
function v_u_18._FetchPlayerData(p_u_109) -- name: _FetchPlayerData
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if p_u_109._player_data_debounce then
		return
	else
		p_u_109._player_data_debounce = true
		local function v110()
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_1, (copy) p_u_109
			return v_u_1.Remotes.Moderator.RequestPlayerData:InvokeServer(p_u_109._ban_data.Name)
		end
		local v111, v112 = pcall(v110)
		p_u_109._player_data_debounce = false
		if v111 then
			if v112 then
				p_u_109.PromptSystem:Open("ViewPlayerData", p_u_109._ban_data.Name, v112)
			else
				p_u_109.PromptSystem:Open("ErrorMessage", "Whoops!", "This player has never played RIVALS before!")
			end
		else
			p_u_109.PromptSystem:Open("ErrorMessage", "Whoops!", "Something went wrong while fetching their data, error:", (tostring(v112)))
			return
		end
	end
end
function v_u_18._RawFetchBanData(p113, p114) -- name: _RawFetchBanData
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_1
	if p113._lookup_disabled then
		return
	else
		p113:SetBanData(true, nil, nil)
		if p114 and #p114 ~= 0 then
			p113._lookup_disabled = true
			p113.PlayerWaitingFrame.Visible = true
			p113.PlayerWaitingDotsFrame:AddTag("UILoadingDots")
			local v115 = v_u_1.Remotes.Moderator.RequestPlayer:InvokeServer(p114) or {}
			p113:SetBanData(true, table.unpack(v115))
			p113._lookup_disabled = false
			p113.PlayerWaitingFrame.Visible = false
			p113.PlayerWaitingDotsFrame:RemoveTag("UILoadingDots")
		end
	end
end
function v_u_18._FetchBanData(p116) -- name: _FetchBanData
	p116:_RawFetchBanData(p116.LookupBox.Text)
end

function v_u_31._GenerateTasks(p112, p113, p114, p115, _) -- name: _GenerateTasks
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_11, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_23
	local v116 = p113 and { "BonusTasks" } or { "Tasks" }
	if p113 and p115 then
		table.insert(v116, "EventTasks")
	end
	if v_u_11.SPECIAL_CHALLENGES then
		table.insert(v116, "SpecialChallenges")
	end
	table.insert(v116, "LimitedTasks")
	local v117 = v_u_11:GetCurrentlyActiveLimitedTasks()
	for _, v118 in pairs(v116) do
		local v119 = p112._task_containers[v118]
		local v120 = v_u_16:Get(v118)
		if not v120 then
			continue
		end
		local v121 = v118 == "SpecialChallenges" and v_u_11.SPECIAL_CHALLENGES_MUST_BE_COMPLETED_IN_ORDER
		if not v121 then
			if v118 == "LimitedTasks" then
				if v117 then
					v121 = v117.RequiresPreviousTaskCompleted
				else
					v121 = v117
				end
			else
				v121 = false
			end
		end
		local v122 = false
		for v123, v124 in pairs(v120) do
			local v125
			if v121 then
				if v123 > 1 then
					v125 = not v120[v123 - 1].Completed
				else
					v125 = false
				end
			else
				v125 = v121
			end
			local v126 = v_u_23.new(v124)
			v126:SetLocked(v125, v122)
			v126:SetParent(v119.Container.Contents.Slots.Container)
			local v127 = p112._task_slots
			table.insert(v127, v126)
			v122 = v125
		end
	end
	p112:_UpdateDailyTaskStreak(p114, p113)
end
function v_u_31._GenerateContracts(p_u_128) -- name: _GenerateContracts
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_7, (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_28, (copy) v_u_10, (copy) v_u_12, (copy) v_u_22, (copy) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_13, (copy) v_u_26

	local function v149(p131, p132, p133, p134) -- name: generate
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_6, (ref) v_u_130, (ref) v_u_28, (ref) v_u_10, (ref) v_u_12, (copy) p_u_128, (ref) v_u_22

	local function v_u_169(p150, p151, p152) -- name: get_sorted_contracts
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_7, (ref) v_u_16, (copy) v_u_129, (ref) v_u_13
		local v153 = {}
		for _, v154 in pairs(p150) do
			local v155
			if p152 then
				v155 = v_u_7:GetWeaponContracts(v154)
			else
				v155 = v_u_7:GetMapContracts(v154)
			end
			if v155 then
				v155 = v155[p151]
			end
			if not v155 then
				continue
			end
			local v156 = v_u_7.Contracts[v155]
			local v157
			if p152 then
				v157 = v_u_16:GetWeaponStatistic(v156.Identifier, v156.StatisticName, v156.ExtraStatisticNames)
			else
				v157 = v_u_16:GetMapStatistic(v156.Identifier, v156.StatisticName, v156.ExtraStatisticNames)
			end
			for _, v160 in pairs(v156.Milestones) do
				local v159, _ = table.unpack(v160)
				if v159 <= v157 then
					continue
				end
			end
			local v160 = v156.Milestones[#v156.Milestones]
			local v161 = v160[1]
			local v162 = {
				["Name"] = v154,
				["ContractName"] = v155,
				["Progress"] = v157,
				["Goal"] = v161
			}
			local v163
			if p152 then
				v163 = v_u_16:GetWeaponStatistic(v154, "StatisticPlaytime")
			else
				v163 = v_u_16:GetMapStatistic(v154, "StatisticPlaytime")
			end
			v162.FilterPlaytime = v163
			v162.FilterProgress = -(v161 - v157)
			table.insert(v153, v162)
		end
		table.sort(v153, function(p164, p165)
			-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_129, (ref) v_u_13
			local v166 = p164.Progress >= p164.Goal
			local v167 = p165.Progress >= p165.Goal
			if v166 == v167 then
				local v168 = p164[v_u_129] - p165[v_u_129]
				if math.abs(v168) > 0.001 then
					return p164[v_u_129] > p165[v_u_129]
				else
					return v_u_13:StringLessThan(p164.Name, p165.Name)
				end
			else
				return v167
			end
		end)
		return v153
	end
	for _, v170 in pairs({ 3, 5 }) do
		local v171 = v_u_26:Clone()
		v171.LayoutOrder = v170 * 99999
		v171.Parent = p_u_128.ContractsMilestones

		end
		return v_u_169(v175, p174, true)
	end
	for v179 = 1, 2 do

			local v181 = v178(v180, v179)
			for _, v182 in pairs(v181) do
				v149(v182.Name, nil, v182.ContractName, v182.Progress)
			end

	end
	local v186 = (function(p183) -- name: get_sorted_maps

function v_u_31._Init(p_u_215) -- name: _Init
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_15, (copy) v_u_5, (copy) v_u_21
	p_u_215.CloseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_215
		p_u_215:CloseRequest()
	end)
	p_u_215.TasksCompletedRefreshButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_15, (ref) v_u_5
		v_u_15:PromptProductPurchase(v_u_5.Products.RefreshTasks.ProductID)
	end)
	p_u_215.Layout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_215
		p_u_215.List.CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, p_u_215.Layout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
		p_u_215.List.Active = p_u_215.List.CanvasSize.Y.Offset > p_u_215.List.AbsoluteSize.Y
		p_u_215.List.Position = p_u_215.List.Active and UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0) or UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.2, 0)
		p_u_215.CloseButton.Position = p_u_215.List.Active and UDim2.new(1.075, 16, 0.0375, 0) or UDim2.new(1.075, 16, 0.2375, 0)
	end)
	p_u_215.TasksCompletedContentsLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_215
		p_u_215.TasksCompletedFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, p_u_215.TasksCompletedContentsLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
	end)
	p_u_215.ContractsLayout:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteContentSize"):Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_215
		p_u_215.ContractsFrame.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, p_u_215.ContractsContainer.AbsoluteSize.Y * 0.15 + p_u_215.ContractsLayout.AbsoluteContentSize.Y)
	end)
	p_u_215.ContractsFilterButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_215
		p_u_215:_SetPercentContractGoalEnabled(not p_u_215._percent_contract_goal_enabled)
	end)
	p_u_215.ContractsDropdownButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		-- upvalues: (copy) p_u_215
		p_u_215:_StartDropdown()
	end)
	p_u_215:_Setup()
	v_u_21:Add(p_u_215.CloseButton)
	v_u_21:Add(p_u_215.ContractsFilterButton)

		["HoverRatio"] = 1.025
	})
end

	["un"] = function(p406, p407, p408, p409, p410, p411, p412, p413) -- name: un
		if p409 <= 56 then
			if p409 <= 55 then
				return p413 == 212 and 171 or 124, p407, p411, p408, p410
			else
				local v414 = p406[46](p411, p412 + 2)
				if v414 < 128 then
					return 223, p407, v414, p408, p410
				else
					return 221, p407, p411, p408, v414
				end
			end
		elseif p409 <= 57 then
			local v415 = 16384 * (p411 - 128)
			local v416 = p412 + (128 * (p408 - 128) + v415)
			return 46, p407 + 3, v416, p408, p410
		else
			local v417 = (p408 - 128) * 16384
			local v418 = 128 * (p412 - 128) + (v417 + p413)
			return 64, p407, 3 + p411, v418, p410
		end
	end,
	["Xu"] = function(p_u_419, p_u_420, p421, p422, p423, p424, p425, p426, p427) -- name: Xu

local function v_u_90(p74, p75, p76, p77, p78, p79, p80, p81, p82) -- name: add_cosmetic
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_64, (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_65
	local v83 = v_u_64.Rarities[p75] ~= nil
	assert(v83)
	local v84 = not v_u_64.RENAMED_COSMETICS[p76]
	assert(v84)
	local v_u_87 = {
		["Rarity"] = nil,
		["Type"] = nil,
		["Image"] = nil,
		["ImageScale"] = nil,
		["Hidden"] = nil,
		["Description"] = nil,
		["DescriptionSpecific"] = nil,
		["GetDescription"] = nil,
		["Rarity"] = p75,
		["Type"] = p74,
		["Image"] = p77 or "",
		["ImageScale"] = p78 or 1,
		["Hidden"] = p79,
		["Description"] = p80,
		["DescriptionSpecific"] = p81,
		["GetDescription"] = function(p85)
			-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_87
			local v86 = p85 and v_u_87.DescriptionSpecific or v_u_87.Description
			if v86 then
				return tostring(v86)
			else
				return nil
			end
		end
	}
	for v88, v89 in pairs(p82 or {}) do
		v_u_87[v88] = v89
	end
	v_u_64.Cosmetics[p76] = v_u_87
	if v_u_4.IS_SERVER then
		if v_u_65[p76] then
			error("[ITEM] Duplicate item name: " .. p76)
			return
		end
		v_u_65[p76] = true
	end
end
local function v100(p91, p92, p93, p94, p95, p96) -- name: add_skin
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_6, (copy) v_u_90
	local v97 = v_u_6.ViewModels[p93]
	local v98 = v97 ~= nil
	assert(v98, p93)
	local v99 = {
		["ItemName"] = p92,
		["ImageHighResolution"] = v97.ImageHighResolution
	}
	v_u_90("Skin", p91, p93, v97.Image, 3, p94, p95, p96, v99)
end

local function v122(p101, p102, p103, p104, p105, p106, p107, p108) -- name: add_wrap
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_2, (copy) v_u_90
	local v109 = {
		["WrapGroups"] = {}
	}
	for _, v110 in pairs({ p103, p104, p105 }) do
		local v111, v112, v113, v114, v115, v116 = table.unpack(v110)
		local v117 = typeof(v111) == "string"
		local v118
		if v117 then
			v118 = v_u_2.Wraps:WaitForChild(v111)
		else
			v118 = v117
		end
		local v119 = {}
		local v120 = v118 and v118.BaseMaterial
		if not v120 then
			if v117 or not v111 then
				v120 = nil
			else
				v120 = v111
			end
		end
		v119.Material = v120
		v119.MaterialVariant = v117 and v111 and v111 or ""
		v119.Color = v112 or nil
		v119.Transparency = v113 or nil
		v119.Reflectance = v114 or nil
		v119.Textures = v115 or nil
		v119.ObjectName = v116
		local v121 = v109.WrapGroups
		table.insert(v121, v119)
	end
	v_u_90("Wrap", p101, p102, nil, nil, p106, p107, p108, v109)
end

local function v_u_173(p_u_149, p150, p151, p152, p153, p154, p_u_155, p156) -- name: add_lootbox
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_143, (copy) v_u_64, (copy) v_u_8, (copy) v_u_6
	v_u_143("Lootbox", p151, p151, p152, p154, nil, {
		["SmartRestrictionsEnabled"] = nil,
		["LootboxDescription"] = nil,
		["SoundProfile"] = nil,
		["GetContents"] = nil,
		["HasWeaponCosmetics"] = false,
		["SmartRestrictionsEnabled"] = not p150,
		["LootboxDescription"] = p156 or "Contains special items!",
		["SoundProfile"] = p153
	})
	local v157 = v_u_64.Rewards[p151]
	local v158 = v_u_64.LootboxOrder
	table.insert(v158, p151)
	function v157.GetContents(p159)
		-- upvalues: (ref) v_u_8, (copy) p_u_155, (copy) p_u_149, (ref) v_u_64
		local v160 = v_u_8:CloneTable(p_u_155)
		if not p_u_149 then
			v160 = {}
			for _, v161 in pairs(v160) do
				local v162 = {
					["Name"] = nil,
					["Quantity"] = 1,
					["Weapon"] = nil,
					["Name"] = v161,
					["Weapon"] = v_u_64.Cosmetics[v161] and v_u_64.Cosmetics[v161].ItemName or (v_u_64.Cosmetics[v161] and v_u_64.Types[v_u_64.Cosmetics[v161].Type].IsWeaponCosmetic and "IsRandom" or (v_u_64.Rewards[v161] and v_u_64.Rewards[v161].Type == "Lootbox" and "IsRandom" or nil))
				}
				table.insert(v160, {
					["Weight"] = 1,
					["Reward"] = nil,
					["Reward"] = v162
				})
			end
		end
		local v163 = 0
		for _, v164 in pairs(v160) do
			v163 = v163 + v164.Weight
			if not p159 or v164.Reward.Weapon ~= "IsRandom" then
				continue
			end
			v164.Reward.Weapon = p159
		end
		return v160, v163
	end
	local v165 = {}
	for _, v166 in pairs(v157.GetContents()) do
		local v167 = v166.Reward.Name
		if not p_u_149 then
			local v168 = not v165[v167]
			assert(v168, v167)
			v165[v167] = true
		end
		local v169 = v_u_64.Cosmetics[v167]
		local v170 = v_u_6.Items[v167]
		local v171 = v_u_64.Rewards[v167]
		if v169 then
			v_u_64.Cosmetics[v167].Description = "Unboxed from the " .. p151
			v_u_64.CosmeticNameToLootbox[v167] = p151
			if not v_u_64.Types[v169.Type].IsWeaponCosmetic then
				continue
			end
			v157.HasWeaponCosmetics = true
		else
			if v170 then
				continue
			end
			if v171 then
				if v171.Type ~= "Lootbox" or not v171.HasWeaponCosmetics then
					continue
				end
				v157.HasWeaponCosmetics = true
			else
				local v172 = p151 .. ", " .. v167
				assert(false, v172)
			end
		end
	end
end

local function v_u_79(...) -- name: add_setting
	-- upvalues: (copy) v_u_4, (copy) v_u_72
	local v73 = v_u_4.new(...)
	local v74 = v_u_72.Info
	local v75 = v73.Name
	local v76
	if v73.Type == "Divider" then
		v76 = nil

	end
	v74[v75] = v76
	local v77 = v_u_72.Order
	table.insert(v77, v73)
	v_u_72.OrderBySections[v73.Section] = v_u_72.OrderBySections[v73.Section] or {}
	local v78 = v_u_72.OrderBySections[v73.Section]
	table.insert(v78, v73)
end

		end
	end

	end

		["DataNames"] = v562,
		["Descriptions"] = p561
	}
end
